name: TelcoLane
description: TelcoLane, a telecom Subscriber & Plan Lifecycle Management Platform. It handles subscriber self-registration and rule-based activation (KYC, dealer code, MNP, all stubbed), a versioned prepaid/postpaid plan catalog with immutable published plans, plan upgrade/downgrade with pro-rata billing, suspend/resume, a 7-day port-out cooling-period workflow, CSR overrides with audit trail, and admin reports (activation funnel, churn, plan mix, stubbed ARPU). All money is computed with Decimal. State transitions, plan versions, billing records and overrides are append-only. PII is masked in logs. Roles are subscriber, CSR, admin and dealer.

start_commands: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
